capabilities: Display month, week, day, and agenda calendar views
Read time-stamped tasks and list items from daily notes
Drag, drop, and resize timed events and all-day tasks
Open the source note when selecting an event
Configure week start, event insertion heading, and visible time range
extras: The plugin listing carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README covers features, time formats, settings, and manual installation but no screenshots or usage walkthrough.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar that plots timed tasks from daily notes on a time-grid timeline.
summary: Calendar plugin that renders month, week, day, and agenda views of time-stamped tasks and events read from daily notes.
